name: The crystal that is not the answer

date.label: The Burning Crusade · quest sequence; exact date unknown

summary: At Area 52, Khay’ji says Nexus-Prince Haramad wants a crystal artifact from old draenei ruins. The Burning Legion has begun digging there, and the quest points to Pentatharon, a dreadlord holding one candidate. When Khay’ji examines what returns, he finds nothing special and doubts it is the crystal the prince seeks. Yet the Legion’s work seems directed toward something particular. The first prize is a false lead; the search itself has gained urgency.
